title: anderson-putnam-direct-limit
description: The Anderson-Putnam direct-limit construction adopted for the aperiodic regime: the direct limit of finite-stage cohomology of the bounded aperiodic-nuclear-quartet sub-sites under the settling endofunctor's iterate, assembling the classifying first cohomology at the closure ordinal. The settling iterate plays the role of the substitution self-map and the stacked quartet diamonds play the role of the Anderson-Putnam complex.

finiteStageCohomology.description: the cohomology of each finite-stage bounded sub-site T*_{<=tau}, playing the role of the Cech cohomology of the Anderson-Putnam complex; coefficients are abelian groups

grade.description: the quartet grade tau whose bounded sub-site cohomology is taken

coefficients.description: abelian-group coefficients, shared with tiling Cech cohomology

iterateMap.description: the induced cohomology map between consecutive grades, played by the settling endofunctor's iterate (the analogue of the substitution self-map omega*)

morphism.description: passage from one aperiodic-nuclear-quartet grade to the next

role.description: the structural role of omega* in the Anderson-Putnam framework

directLimit.description: the direct limit (colimit) over the stacked diamonds of the non-stabilizing orbit, taken at the closure ordinal omega_1

closureOrdinal.description: the ordinal at which the direct limit is assembled

classifyingCohomology.description: the classifying first cohomology of the aperiodic regime

structuralAnalogyOnly.description: only the direct-limit framework transfers; the tiling-specific machinery (C*-algebras, K-theory, Anderson-Putnam collaring, branched-manifold inverse limits) is not invoked
